title: Opening Line Lab
purpose: Put every opening beside the scene and evidence that must support it.
disclosure: FICTIONAL WORKED EXAMPLE. All products, feedback and constraints here are synthetic. No campaign has run and no performance result is claimed.

sources.label: Fictional product brief
sources.text: A fictional packing cube has a labeled divider and two zipped compartments. No tested time saving, capacity gain or durability claim is supplied.

sources.label: Positive feedback
sources.text: I could see which side held the clean shirts.

sources.label: Mixed feedback
sources.text: The divider helped, but the cube felt bulky in my small bag.

sources.label: Unresolved buyer question
sources.text: Will it fit my 18 litre backpack?

sources.label: Production inventory
sources.text: One prototype, one phone, one tabletop and one editor are available. No customer testimonial footage is licensed.

cards.title: Let the feature carry the opening

fields.Implied promise: The viewer can inspect two zipped compartments.
fields.First frame: Open the prototype and move a shirt into each labeled compartment.
fields.Proof beat: Show the real feature without a cut that changes its state. Use synthetic records where relevant.
fields.Transition: Invite the viewer to inspect the product details.
fields.Test note: Draft only. Keep the body identical if comparing openings.

cards.next: Read aloud, check silent comprehension and capture the proof beat.

cards.title: Name the unresolved check
cards.decision: Before packing a small bag, what do you need to check?

fields.Opening line: Before packing a small bag, what do you need to check?
fields.Implied promise: The ad will name a relevant check, not guarantee compatibility.
fields.First frame: Place the question beside the product, without implying a passing test.
fields.Proof beat: Will it fit my 18 litre backpack?
fields.Transition: Invite inspection of verified specifications; do not imply the answer is yes.
fields.Test note: Use only after the answer and matching footage exist.

cards.next: Replace the question with a demonstrated answer once verified.

cards.title: A number the evidence cannot carry
cards.decision: Pack twice as much in half the time.

fields.Opening line: Pack twice as much in half the time.
fields.Implied promise: A quantified improvement for every user.
fields.Transition: Replace with the feature inspection line.
fields.Rejection reason: The numerical promise exceeds the evidence; attention does not justify it.

cards.next: Discard this draft from the production shortlist.
